But, to be honest, I'm a bit lack of comfort when using it, because the app is slow, and not responsive. I believe it happens because there's no good caching mechanism. So I suggest you have to improve in the caching strategy. For example, use cache for every static data like image, don't store it in a persistent DB, because persistent DB is so slow since it needs disk to proceed the data search. Also, configuration-related data, whose the intensity of change is low, u have to let cache as the first layer db, so every data request should be searched in cache first. Look at persistent DB only if the data no longer exist in cache. I believe it will make Jenius Jenius because of its responsiveness.
